headline: Build a Zero-API-Cost AI Agent That Runs 100% Locally
summary: This new framework, LocalMind, runs entirely on your machine via Ollama or WebGPU, eliminating recurring costs and data privacy concerns.
details: Tired of expensive API tokens and sending data to third-party servers, one developer built LocalMind — a lightweight AI agent framework that runs entirely on their own machine.
The agent utilizes Ollama or WebGPU for local execution, requiring no API keys, no telemetry, and no recurring costs. This ensures your data never leaves your machine.
LocalMind features a full ReAct loop (Reason → Act → Observe) with tool calling, streaming output, conversation memory, and JSON Schema validation.
Written in vanilla ESM JavaScript, the framework boasts zero runtime dependencies, making it easy to integrate and use.
The developer shared a code snippet demonstrating how to initialize the agent with Ollama and use built-in tools like a calculator and date/time functions.
caption:
Stop paying for AI APIs! Build your own zero-cost AI agent that runs entirely locally.

Tired of expensive API tokens and sending data to third-party servers, one developer built LocalMind — a lightweight AI agent framework that runs entirely on their own machine.

The agent utilizes Ollama or WebGPU for local execution, requiring no API keys, no telemetry, and no recurring costs. This ensures your data never leaves your machine.

LocalMind features a full ReAct loop (Reason → Act → Observe) with tool calling, streaming output, conversation memory, and JSON Schema validation.

Written in vanilla ESM JavaScript, the framework boasts zero runtime dependencies, making it easy to integrate and use.

The developer shared a code snippet demonstrating how to initialize the agent with Ollama and use built-in tools like a calculator and date/time functions.

headline: iPhone 18 Pro gets better thermals and battery life, smaller Dynamic Island
summary: Apple's latest flagship boasts a new 2nm A20 Pro chip and improved cooling, making it cooler to the touch and delivering better sustained performance.
details: The iPhone 18 Pro offers iterative updates over its predecessor, focusing on under-the-hood improvements rather than radical design changes. Key upgrades include a new 2nm A20 Pro chip, enhanced battery life, and significantly improved thermal management.

The new A20 Pro chip, built on a 2nm process, features a 6-core CPU and a 7-core GPU with a Neural Accelerator for AI tasks. It also supports hardware-accelerated ray-tracing and a dual 16-core Neural Engine for local AI features in iOS 27.
Thermal management has been a major focus, with the phone remaining cooler to the touch and offering better sustained performance. This addresses a common concern with high-performance smartphones.
The Dynamic Island has been made smaller by moving the IR camera under the OLED display. This allows for up to three live activities to be displayed, with the middle one showing more information.

While not a revolutionary leap, the iPhone 18 Pro is presented as a refined workhorse. Apple appears to be reserving more experimental design elements for other product lines, positioning the Pro models as reliable, high-performance devices.

New camera controls, including a variable aperture, offer more granular options for mobile photography enthusiasts. This is a welcome addition for those seeking more control over computational photography.
The phone maintains a familiar design with premium materials. A new burgundy color option is available, though it is noted to be a fingerprint magnet, a common trait for iPhones.
